data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1 (partial): CLAUDE.md \"Architecture\" section reflects the new `dso_ci_review/` module layout. References to `llm-api-call.sh` are removed or replaced with module references; references to `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` describe the shim semantics and the underlying module.

## Context
`llm-api-call.sh` was deleted (not deprecated) in story e596. `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` is now a 29-line shim that execs `python3 -m dso_ci_review.runner`. CLAUDE.md still describes the old bash behavior.

## Files to Change
- `CLAUDE.md` line ~97: \"Tiered review\" paragraph ends with \"(see `llm-api-call.sh`)\" — remove this reference since the file is deleted.
- `CLAUDE.md` line ~117: \"CI llm-review orchestrator\" entry describes `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` as the real implementation and `llm-api-call.sh` as its dispatch helper. Update to describe `dso_ci_review.runner` as the real implementation, with `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` as a thin shim that resolves plugin root, sets PYTHONPATH, and execs `python3 -m dso_ci_review.runner`.

## Implementation Steps
1. In `CLAUDE.md`, find the \"Tiered review\" paragraph (search for `see \`llm-api-call.sh\``) and remove the parenthetical reference to `llm-api-call.sh`.
2. In `CLAUDE.md`, find the \"CI llm-review orchestrator\" section and rewrite it to:
   - Name `dso_ci_review.runner` (Python module at `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py`) as the real implementation
   - Describe `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` as a 29-line shim that resolves `_PLUGIN_ROOT`, sets `PYTHONPATH`, maps `--overlay-*` CLI flags to env vars, then execs `python3 -m dso_ci_review.runner`
   - Retain accurate facts: auto-detects local-checkout vs fetched-assets mode via marker file `plugins/dso/.dso-source-of-truth`; parallel overlay dispatch; does not consult `check-usage.sh`
   - Remove the claim that dispatch happens \"via `llm-api-call.sh`\" (that file is deleted)

## No Compat Wrapper Needed
Story e596 deleted `llm-api-call.sh` directly. Story e71e (S7) states \"if added in S6\" — since S6 did not add a compat wrapper, no wrapper exists and none should be created. Document this decision in the CLAUDE.md update if space permits (a one-line note is sufficient).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] CLAUDE.md contains no reference to `llm-api-call.sh`
  Verify: ! grep -q "llm-api-call" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CLAUDE.md
- [ ] CLAUDE.md \"CI llm-review orchestrator\" section references `python3 -m dso_ci_review.runner` or `dso_ci_review.runner`
  Verify: grep -q "dso_ci_review.runner" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CLAUDE.md
- [ ] CLAUDE.md \"CI llm-review orchestrator\" section describes `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` as a shim
  Verify: grep -A3 "CI llm-review orchestrator" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CLAUDE.md | grep -qi "shim"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Update CLAUDE.md CI orchestrator section to reflect Python module migration
